content.title: About
content.content: The egg white sandwich is a light, protein‑rich snack made with two slices of whole‑grain bread, a fluffy egg‑white omelet, lettuce, tomato, and a slice of low‑fat cheese. Egg whites provide high‑quality protein with minimal fat and cholesterol.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Egg whites are almost pure protein and contain virtually no fat.
Athletes and calorie‑conscious eaters often choose egg white sandwiches for their low energy density.
Cooking egg whites without added oil preserves most of their nutritional value.
Whole‑grain bread adds dietary fiber that supports digestion.
The combination of protein and complex carbs gives lasting satiety.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Egg whites contain all essential amino acids, helping muscle repair and supporting metabolism.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Unlike whole eggs, egg whites have virtually no fat, making the sandwich suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Egg whites provide riboflavin (B2) and cobalamin (B12), important for energy production.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Lysosome and lactoferrin in egg whites have antibacterial properties.

items.title: Fiber from whole‑grain bread
items.content: Fiber improves gut health and helps maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg whites, ranging from skin rashes to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If salty sauces or cheese are added, the sandwich can become high in sodium, which is a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Possible salmonella risk
items.content: Undercooked egg whites may carry a risk of salmonella; always cook until fully set.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the sandwich warm, cut in half for easy handling. It’s perfect as a quick on‑the‑go snack. Add avocado, mustard, or a light yogurt spread for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the assembled sandwich in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. For longer storage keep components separate: bread in a dry place, egg white filling refrigerated.
